desc: The all-new 110 RF Magpul brings the 22LR into a full-size platform. Built on the proven 110 action, the new 110 RF Magpul is designed to perform. Like its big brother, this rifle is capable of using stocks or accessories designed for a Savage 110 short action rifle. The bolt has been designed with the same headspace control that the 110 is known for. The unique front baffle allows the user to interchange the length of bolt throw. It can be configured for a standard 308 Win length throw or shortened to the 22LR length throw. This enables the user to cycle the bolt faster with the 22LR length throw or use it to train with the full-length bolt throw just like a 308 Win. Changing the length of bolt throw can be completed in under 30 seconds and can be swapped at anytime. Feeding from an L3i 10 round AICS style magazine, the 110 RF’s match grade chamber will ensure optimum accuracy shot after shot.
